screens={r[\"ScreenID\"] for r in strict}
qs={r[\"ScreenID\"] for r in qualified}

assert not qs&us and len(qualified)==2122 and len(qs)==1031 and len(unqualified)==920 and len(us)==336
assert len(unknown)==5 and len({r[\"ScreenID\"] for r in unknown})==3
rep={k:v for k,v in content.items() if len(v)>1}
assert len(content)==1030 and len(rep)==1
assert list(rep)==[(\"ACH-000614\",\"adherent\",\"RPMI + 10% FBS\",\"Avana\",\"21\")]
assert next(iter(rep.values()))=={\"SC-000614.AV01\",\"SC-002875.AV01\"}
cand=[r for r in strict if r[\"ScreenID\"] in next(iter(rep.values()))]
assert len(cand)==4
condition_ids={r[\"ModelConditionID\"] for r in cand}
conditions=[mc[x] for x in sorted(condition_ids)]
assert len(conditions)==2
diff=[k for k in conditions[0] if conditions[0][k]"'!=conditions[1][k]]
assert diff==["ModelConditionID"],diff
assert {r["pDNABatch"] for r in cand}=={"Avana-3","Avana-4"}
assert all(not m["PassageNumber"].strip() for m in conditions)
screenmap=rows("CRISPRScreenMap.csv")
mapped={r["ScreenID"]:r["ModelID"] for r in screenmap}
assert all(mapped[r["ScreenID"]]==r["ModelID"] for r in cand)
passport_ids=[]
with (root/"data/passports_model_list_20260921.csv").open(newline="") as f:
    rdr=csv.reader(f)
    header=next(rdr)

            passport_ids.append(rec)
assert passport_ids and {r["patient_id"] for r in passport_ids}=={"SIDP01038"}
assert f"{100*len(unqualified)/len(strict):.2f}"=="30.24"

assert f"{100*len(rep)/len(content):.4f}"=="0.0971"
print(json.dumps({"total":len(seq),"pDNA_excluded":len(seq)-len(base),"strict_sequences":len(strict),"strict_screens":len(screens),"missing_flags_excluded":len(missing),"qualified_sequences":len(qualified),"qualified_screens":len(qs),"unqualified_sequences":len(unqualified),"unqualified_screens":len(us),"qualified_unqualified_overlap":len(qs&us),"unknown_format_sequences":len(unknown),"unknown_format_screens":len({r["ScreenID"] for r in unknown}),"screen_types":dict(Counter(r["ScreenType"] for r in strict)),"content_screens_per_group":dict(Counter(len(s) for s in content.values())),"candidate_conditions":conditions,"candidate_sequences":cand,"passport_identifiers":passport_ids,"status":"all independent assertions pass"},indent=2))
